name: @prismux/appearance
description: Prismux celestial 3-state theme capsule, floating liquid-glass color popover, appearance cards, contrast-clamped glass engine, and Prismux Tailwind v4 token bridge.

scripts.build:
tsc --rootDir src && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; fs.mkdirSync('dist/styles', { recursive: true }); const files = ['celestial-capsule.css', 'color-popover.css', 'appearance-cards.css', 'prismux-glass-bridge.css', 'floating-scrollbar.css']; const chunks = files.map((file) => { const css = fs.readFileSync(path.join('src/styles', file), 'utf8'); fs.writeFileSync(path.join('dist/styles', file), css); return '/* === ' + file + ' === */
' + css; }); fs.writeFileSync('dist/styles.css', chunks.join('

') + '
